author: reek
body: Omni-directional shadows from a point light. A bright point light sits among a ring of spheres on a floor; for every shaded point a shadow ray is cast toward the light and tested against all spheres, so each sphere casts shadows that radiate outward in every direction and fall on its neighbours and the floor. One thread per pixel. Reference site's "omni directional shadow mapping" technique (point-light shadows). Float math from DeviceMath.
